items.html: And behold, it has already been explained that since the name SAG also served merely for passage, and is hinted at in the three simple Yud-Hei-Vav which total SAG in Gematria, therefore in their Miluim [fillings] too a hint is given, in that the Yud-Hei-Vav of the Milui of SAG, thus: Yud, Hei, Vav, totals 48 in Gematria, and together with the aforementioned Chekel [field] it is a place, which is the name HaVaYaH, thus: Yud-Peh-Yud, Hei-Peh-Hei, Vav-Peh-Vav, Hei-Peh-Hei. And this is also the secret of "behold, a place is with Me," meaning, the letter Yud, for this drop came out from Chochma, called Yud, and the drop itself is also Yud as mentioned, and it becomes a place.
